name: jev-bench decision_conflict and task_depends case format

common.Case: {id, difficulty: easy|medium|hard, why, seed, action: {agent, tool, args}, expect, uncertain?: string}
common.seed: lab schema seed (notices, contracts, decisions, memory, tasks, claims, active_agents); acting agent is in active_agents
common.tolerated: optional string[] of seeded keys scored as neither hit nor false flag; disjoint from the main label list

action.args: {title, decision, rationale, alternatives?: string[], affects_paths: string[]}

decision_conflict.expect: {supersedes: string[] (seeded decision keys, may be empty), tolerated?: string[]}
decision_conflict.metrics: pair AUC over (new, seeded) pairs excluding tolerated (headline); precision/recall of flagged keys; false_flags_per_20_records; exact match; tolerated flags reported separately; path-overlap baseline
decision_conflict.seed: decisions only (6-7 rows, array order = recording order, later is newer); other lists empty

task_depends.expect: {depends_on: string[] (keys of OPEN seeded tasks only, direct prerequisites, may be empty), tolerated?: string[] (open keys)}
task_depends.metrics: micro precision (headline) and recall excluding tolerated; top-1 correct on non-empty cases; false suggestions per empty-label case; suggestions of done tasks (always wrong); path-overlap baseline
task_depends.seed: tasks only (4-12); pulled_by without done_by = in_progress, both = done

current.notes: Blind labels (no Jev) from task 3e035902. 46 decision_conflict cases (dc-001..026 from this repo's decisions/ADRs, dc-027..046 synthetic billing API), 41 task_depends cases (tdep-001..027 from this repo's task board with file names/paths/ids stripped from text, tdep-028..041 synthetic).
